comment: Source read at commit f427150. The installed plugin.json carries 2.0.0, which seventeen commits share; the installed res/RackNES.svg and res/CVGenie.svg hash to the blobs first appearing at d720ac5, and the installed build has no theme support, so it predates f6bdefe (prototype theme support) — src/ is byte-identical from d720ac5 to f427150, the last 2.0.0 commit before the theme work. MANUAL AGAINST CODE ON THE AUDIO LEVEL: the manual calls each voice output and the mix 10V peak to peak, but nes/emulator.hpp:254 multiplies the sample by 10 and divides by the full scale of a signed 16-bit sample, so a full-scale sample would come out at 10V peak, 20V peak to peak, and the knob can double that again at 200%. No figure is quoted in the lines because how close the emulated sound gets to full scale was not established. The constructor calls emulator.set_clock_rate(768000) rather than the console's 1789773, so the sound library's own time base is fixed at 768kHz; the clock speed knob changes how many processor cycles are run per Rack sample, not that figure. RackNES.cpp:92 declares a PulseGenerator called clockGenerator that nothing ever uses; the clock output is a plain square wave from is_clock_high. processCV runs at every sixteenth sample (cvDivider set to 16 at line 188), and when save, reset and load all arrive together they are taken in that order so the emulation is left where it started. The screen is a display widget with no parameter behind it, so it cannot be clicked for help.
